# Nexnews

> Autonomous AI-Powered Global News & Search Trend Portal

Nexnews is an automated news and intelligence portal delivering real-time coverage across Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Business, World News, and Sports.

## Core Features & Content
- Real-time global trending search topic synthesis and analysis.
- Structured news reporting covering Tech, World, Business, AI, and Sports.
- Instant indexation and search-intent resolution.
